name: isOWAOfflineAccessDisabled
definition: Outlook on the web offline access is off for every OWA mailbox policy in use: AllowOfflineOn is NoComputers on each. False when a policy in use allows PrivateComputersOnly or AllComputers.
population: OWA mailbox policies of the tenant, narrowed to those in use by OWA-enabled mailboxes (the default policy counts when a mailbox has none assigned)
evidenceRequiredForTrue: every policy is NoComputers, or every policy in use is NoComputers on a complete usage read

changeLog.change: Registered at V0 so the key stops being grandfathered by the allowlist; proposed, single emitter, definition taken from the emitting transform.
